problem: Three high-priority MKB Voice-of-Customer content candidates existed only as short editorial records and the first web implementation failed the technical SEO contract.
root_cause: The content candidates were promoted to web artifacts before all release-eligible blog requirements were encoded in the article build: exact focus-keyword placement, FAQPage structured data, functional figures, distribution surfaces and same-lineage learning/documentation closure.
prevention: Problemradar blog candidates must pass the full Blog Technical SEO Gate before protected merge.
Focus keyword must be present in title, meta description, first 100 words and an H2; meta descriptions must stay within the repository contract.
Every new publishable blog must carry FAQPage structured data, at least three unique internal links and at least two functional figures with captions.
Qualitative entrepreneur/forum signals must remain labeled qualitative; quantitative claims require a traceable quantitative source.
Multi-article editorial releases must reuse the protected website delivery path and must not bypass the one-canonical-per-day automated publisher ledger.
Material content releases must include Brain learning, development ledger and human-readable change documentation in the same lineage.
